challenges.rule: Pareto: no selected metric worse beyond its explicit tolerance, and at least one strictly better; all enabled guards and both budget caps must pass.

runs.verification: Both plans recomputed locally with frozen inputs and complete monthly capital observations. Caller-supplied outcome numbers are never trusted.
limitations: Synthetic model challenge, not an empirical policy ranking.
Winning means Pareto improvement under the frozen metrics/tolerances, declared action menu, budget cap and enabled guards. These are explicit normative game rules.
Budget grading permits only the frozen1e-6 synthetic USD floating-point tolerance; recorded spending remains unrounded.
Capital cost excludes operating expense, private construction and unmodeled administrative costs. It is not a full fiscal or welfare assessment.
No link was sent, no live city was mutated, and no server-authenticated leaderboard result was created.
